Run the Full Aggregation Pipeline on a NICHESObject

Source: R/aggregate_NICHESObject.R
aggregate_NICHESObject.Rd

A convenience wrapper that calls all aggregation functions in the correct dependency order, populating the $aggregations slot in a single call. Both steps always fully recompute and replace their slots – there is no incremental update mode. Individual functions can still be called directly for finer control.

Usage

aggregate_NICHESObject(
  niches.obj,
  cell.type.col = NULL,
  n.cores = 1L,
  chunk.size = 50L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

niches.obj

A NICHESObject with neighborhood slots populated.

cell.type.col

Character or NULL. Name of the column in $cell.meta holding cell type annotations, passed to add_neighborhood_composition. When NULL (default), step 2 is skipped.

n.cores

Positive integer. Retained for API compatibility; passed to add_neighborhood_edge_agg but not currently used by the sparse matrix implementation. Default 1L.

chunk.size

Positive integer. Number of LRM pairs processed per sparse matrix batch in add_neighborhood_edge_agg. Smaller values reduce peak memory; larger values are marginally faster. Default 50L. Reduce to between 20L and 30L on memory-constrained machines (e.g. laptops); increase on HPC nodes with abundant RAM.

verbose

Logical. Emit progress messages. Default TRUE.

Value

The input niches.obj with $aggregations populated:

$neighborhood.edge.agg

Always populated (five-category edge aggregation keyed on (cell, LRM), with all three score methods and in/out ratio).

$neighborhood.composition

Populated when cell.type.col is provided and mode = "spatial".

Pipeline steps

  1. add_neighborhood_edge_agg: for each focal cell and each LRM pair, aggregates scores across all neighborhood edges using a five-way classification (in, out, cross, self.autocrine, other.autocrine). All three score methods (sum, mean, cmean) and the in/out ratio are always computed. LRM pairs are processed in batches of chunk.size to bound peak memory.

  2. add_neighborhood_composition: computes cell-type composition of each cell's local neighborhood from $edge.list and $cell.meta. Skipped if cell.type.col = NULL or if the object mode is "nonspatial".

Neighborhood slots requirement

Step 1 requires the three neighborhood slots to be populated. create_NICHESObject populates them automatically using edge.filter.mode = "both_in_neighborhood" and remove.autocrine = FALSE, so this requirement is met in the standard workflow.

See also

add_neighborhood_edge_agg, add_neighborhood_composition

Examples

# \donttest{
data(NICHESv2_example)

# Edge aggregation only
obj <- aggregate_NICHESObject(NICHESv2_example, n.cores = 1L)
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Starting aggregation pipeline ...
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Step 1/2: neighborhood edge aggregation.
#> [add_neighborhood_edge_agg] Aggregating 80 cells x 15 LRMs x 1364 neighborhood edges (chunk.size = 50) ...
#>   [add_neighborhood_edge_agg] chunk 1 / 1 done.
#> [add_neighborhood_edge_agg] Done. 399 rows | 74 cells | 15 LRM pairs.
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Step 2/2: SKIPPED -- 'cell.type.col' not provided. Supply cell.type.col to compute neighborhood composition.
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Pipeline complete. Slots populated: neighborhood.edge.agg.
names(obj$aggregations)
#> [1] "neighborhood.edge.agg"

# With cell-type composition
obj <- aggregate_NICHESObject(
  NICHESv2_example,
  cell.type.col = "celltype",
  n.cores       = 1L
)
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Starting aggregation pipeline ...
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Step 1/2: neighborhood edge aggregation.
#> [add_neighborhood_edge_agg] Aggregating 80 cells x 15 LRMs x 1364 neighborhood edges (chunk.size = 50) ...
#>   [add_neighborhood_edge_agg] chunk 1 / 1 done.
#> [add_neighborhood_edge_agg] Done. 399 rows | 74 cells | 15 LRM pairs.
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Step 2/2: neighborhood composition.
#> [add_neighborhood_composition] Computing composition across 80 cells | 3 cell types ...
#> [add_neighborhood_composition] Done. 80 cells | 3 cell types | columns: count + prop.
#> [aggregate_NICHESObject] Pipeline complete. Slots populated: neighborhood.edge.agg, neighborhood.composition.
# }
